title: AI-Powered Indian Sign Language (ISL) Detection and Translation
summary: IIIT Hyderabad is developing an ISL recognition and translation proof of concept. Communication and education benefits remain prospective.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: IIIT Hyderabad is developing an ISL recognition and translation proof of concept. Communication and education benefits remain prospective. Proof of concept in development.
purpose: Translate Indian Sign Language into accessible spoken or written communication.
system: Indian Sign Language detection and translation system
developer: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad

ratings.reason: Deaf and hard-of-hearing people are intended to gain communication and educational access.
Schools and service providers are intended to provide translation; no real deployment outcome is supplied.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: AI-Powered Indian Sign Language (ISL) Detection and Translation

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Representative sign-language data and pose-recognition models
